annotations.title: Business forms a foreigner may use in Poland

description: All Polish business forms (sole proprietorship JDG, unregistered activity, sp. z o.o., P.S.A., S.A., general, limited and professional partnerships, branch, representative office) with available yes/no for the owner status, the reason, conditions (e.g. PESEL for CEIDG) and facts on capital, liability, registration and tax, each with the legal basis.

owner_status.description: eu-eea: EU/EEA citizen; swiss: Swiss citizen; third-country-equal: non-EU national with permanent residence, EU long-term residence, a listed temporary residence permit, refugee or temporary protection status, Pole's Card or EU family member; third-country-other: other non-EU national (visa, visa-free, residence permit for running a business); foreign-company-eu-eea / foreign-company-other: a company seated abroad.

name: get_business_forms
title: Business forms a foreigner may use in Poland
